# third_party

NVIDIA runtime and SDK files do not belong in this repository, including ignored
working-tree copies. Install CUDA, cuDNN, TensorRT, and NVRTC on the host and select
them with `JYPPX_CUDA_ROOT`, `JYPPX_CUDNN_ROOT`, and `JYPPX_TENSORRT_ROOT`.

The repository publishes only source, managed assemblies, and bridge-only packages.
It does not mirror or redistribute vendor runtimes.
